meta: AI agents that use a browser can click and type on the web by themselves. Don't hand it off and walk away: watch what it does.

muc.title: Hand it off and walk away
muc.text: A browser agent can click and type on the web by itself. Don't hand it off and walk away; sit and watch it work.

muc.title: Follow every step
muc.text: This kind of agent usually shows the screen it sees and logs every click, keystroke and page it opens.

muc.title: Stop before key buttons
muc.text: Tell it to stop before any pay, send or confirm button, so you make the call.

muc.title: You hold the stop button
muc.text: If it clicks around wildly, stop it right away. Type passwords and OTP codes yourself; never give them to the agent.

muc.title: Mark the stopping points
muc.text: Ask a chatbot to list the steps for finding a bus ticket online, then mark which steps must stop to ask you.
